about: Synthetic calls for a made-up company, Bayside Garage Doors. Every name, number and line was written for this example. Phone numbers use the 555-0100 to 555-0199 range reserved for fiction.

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: Thanks for calling Bayside Garage Doors. This call may be recorded for quality and training.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, thanks for calling Bayside Garage Doors, this is Dana. How can I help?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi Dana, this is Erin. My garage door stopped halfway and now it won't close.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sorry to hear that, Erin. What happens when you press the wall button? Does the motor run at all?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It hums but the door doesn't move. I think a spring might be broken.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That does sound like a spring. When did it start, and is the door stuck open right now?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This morning. It's stuck about two feet open.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay. We have two options: a tech can come tomorrow between 8 and 10 for a $95 service call, or this afternoon after 4 for $140. Which works better?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Tomorrow morning is fine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great, let me book that for you. You're all set for tomorrow between 8 and 10, Erin. You'll get a confirmation text shortly.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Perfect, thanks.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, see you tomorrow.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Luis from Bayside Garage Doors, calling about the quote for a new door.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Oh right, this is Tom. I was going to call you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great to catch you, Tom. Which of the two door styles did you like better?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The insulated one, but honestly it's more than I wanted to spend. The other company was cheaper.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand. The insulated door includes a ten-year warranty on the panels and the install, which is usually what makes up the difference.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Let me talk to my wife about it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Of course. Would it help if I call you back Thursday afternoon to go over it together? I can lock in the current price until then.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yeah, Thursday works.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect. I'll call you Thursday between 2 and 3. Thanks for your time.

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: Thank you for calling Northpoint Supply. This call may be recorded for quality assurance.

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: For orders, press 1. For account questions, press 2.

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: Please hold. Your estimated wait time is less than 15 minutes.

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: Thank you for waiting. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Still on hold with the supplier.

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: Thanks for calling Bayside Garage Doors. Calls are recorded for quality and training.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good morning, Bayside Garage Doors, my name is Priya.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, my name is Grace. I got a quote for a new opener and it seems too much for what it is.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for calling back, Grace. What did the quote include, and what were you hoping to spend?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It was $480 installed. I saw openers online for half that.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's fair. The price includes the install, hauling the old unit away and a five-year warranty, which is what the online price leaves out.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Okay, that makes more sense.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Want me to schedule it? I have Friday at 1 or Monday at 9.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Friday at 1.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Done. You're all set for Friday at 1, and you'll get a confirmation text today.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thanks.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, have a good day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yeah, hello?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, this is Sam. Do you guys fix sensors? My door reverses every time it closes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yeah we do that.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: How much is it usually?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Depends. Could be a lot of things.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Okay. Should I book something?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You can just let us know when you want someone out.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Alright, bye.

turns.speaker: system
turns.text: You've reached Lakeview Property Management. This call may be monitored or recorded for quality purposes. Please hold while we connect you.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Lakeview, this is Ken.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi Ken, this is Dana from Bayside Garage Doors. I'm calling about the three units at your Elm Street building.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Right, two of the doors are sticking and one opener is dead.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Got it. When are tenants usually home, and do you want all three done in one visit?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: One visit if we can. I need to check with the owner on budget first.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Understood. I'll send a quote today, and I'll follow up Monday morning once you've had a chance to look.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That works.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks, talk Monday.

turns.speaker: caller

turns.text: Harbor Clinic, this is Joan.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi Joan, this is Marcus from Bayside Garage Doors, following up on the door you said was noisy.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, it grinds every time it opens. I'm not sure it's worth fixing.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Grinding is usually rollers, which is a small job. What's the door's age, roughly?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Maybe twelve years.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Then rollers are worth it before anything bigger. I'll check the schedule and call you back tomorrow with a time.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sounds good.
